title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along nearby San Marcos corridors, each paired with one specific, publicly documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Coffee and a Light Bite
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Start on North City Drive with small-batch coffee, then check the posted daily hours before planning a morning meetup or study break.
cards.short_summary: A daytime coffee stop in the mixed-use district beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official destination page places Necessity Coffee at 250 North City Drive and documents specialty coffee, pastries, light bites, and daily hours.
cards.source_title: Necessity Coffee | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists hours of 7 AM–2 PM seven days a week; verify before visiting.

cards.title: French Pastries by North City Plaza
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Walk the North City Drive block for croissants, macarons, quiche, or breakfast pastries; check the listed schedule because Monday is closed.
cards.short_summary: A pastry counter with a clearly documented North City address and menu focus.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official page locates Christophe Rull Patisserie at 251 North City Drive and documents French pastries, breakfast items, macarons, and quiches.
cards.source_title: Christophe Rull Patisserie | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists Tuesday–Friday 7 AM–3 PM, Saturday–Sunday 8 AM–4 PM, and Monday closed; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Fresh-Baked Empanadas
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use this North City Drive stop for freshly baked empanadas and other Argentinian dishes; confirm hours since the source lists Sunday closure.
cards.short_summary: An Argentinian food stop on the campus-adjacent North City corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official page locates Milonga Empanadas at 251 North City Drive, Suite 128E, and says its empanadas are freshly baked rather than frozen.
cards.source_title: Milonga Empanadas | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists Monday–Friday noon–8 PM, Saturday 3–8 PM, and Sunday closed; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Sushi, Ramen, and Poke
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Plan a North City Drive meal around sushi, ramen, poke, or a lunch bento; review current service details before making the short trip.
cards.short_summary: A Japanese restaurant with several documented meal formats in one location.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official page places Umami Japanese at 251 North City Drive, Suite 122, and documents sushi, rolls, ramen, poke bowls, and bento boxes.
cards.source_title: Umami Japanese | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday service until 9 PM, Friday–Saturday until 9:30 PM, and Monday closed; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Build a Bowl or Burrito
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Choose a bowl, wrap, burrito, toast, juice, or smoothie on North City Drive; consult the posted schedule because hours vary by weekday.
cards.short_summary: A fast-casual stop centered on customizable multicultural dishes.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official page identifies A Lo Fresco at 250 North City Drive and documents bowls that can also be served as wraps or hot burritos, plus toast, juice, and smoothies.
cards.source_title: A Lo Fresco | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists varying Monday–Saturday daytime hours and Sunday closure; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Wood-Fired Pizza and Pasta
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Head to the North City Drive block for wood-fired pizza or handmade pasta; check the separate lunch and dinner schedules before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A family-oriented Italian meal stop in the North City district.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official page locates Buona Forchetta at 250 North City Drive and documents wood-fired Neapolitan-style pizza, handmade pasta, gluten-free options, and desserts.
cards.source_title: Buona Forchetta | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists Tuesday–Sunday lunch and dinner periods with Monday closed; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Classic and Dairy-Free Scoops
cards.subtitle: North City Drive corridor
cards.notes: Add a dessert stop to a North City Drive walk and look for the current classic, seasonal, or dairy-free flavors before choosing a scoop.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinctive ice-cream stop with dairy-free choices documented.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's destination guide identifies Wynston’s Ice Cream Co. at 250 North City Drive, Suite 7, and documents classic, rotating, and dairy-free flavors.
cards.source_title: How to spend a great day in North City | Journal | North City
cards.access_notes: Current operating hours are not stated on the cited page; verify directly before visiting.

cards.title: Indoor Climbing on Industrial Street
cards.subtitle: Industrial Street corridor
cards.notes: Book or drop in for climbing, bouldering, yoga, or fitness on Industrial Street; review admission, rental, and supervision details first.
cards.short_summary: A large indoor climbing facility just west of the North City core.
cards.evidence_claim: North City's official page places Mesa Rim at 285 Industrial Street and documents indoor climbing, bouldering, youth programs, yoga, and fitness programming.
cards.source_title: Mesa Rim North City | What’s Here | North City
cards.access_notes: The source lists Monday–Friday 6 AM–10 PM and Saturday–Sunday 8 AM–9 PM; admission or membership is required.

cards.title: Library Time at Civic Center
cards.subtitle: Civic Center Drive corridor
cards.notes: Use the Civic Center Drive branch for reading, research, or a scheduled public program; check the county page for that day's opening window.
cards.short_summary: A county library branch anchoring the Civic Center corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The San Diego County Library's official branch page places San Marcos Library at 2 Civic Center Drive and publishes current daily hours and branch events.
cards.source_title: San Marcos | San Diego County Library
cards.access_notes: Published hours vary by day, with closing times from 5 PM to 7 PM; confirm the live branch page before visiting.

cards.title: Fields, Skate Plaza, and Trails
cards.subtitle: Mission Hills Court corridor
cards.notes: Bring appropriate gear for the skate plaza, fields, dog park, or trail connection, and follow posted park and facility rules during your visit.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose city park northeast of campus with several activity choices.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of San Marcos places Hollandia Park at 12 Mission Hills Court and documents a skate plaza, dog park, lighted fields, amphitheater, restrooms, and trail connection.
cards.source_title: Hollandia Park | City of San Marcos, California
cards.access_notes: The cited facility page does not publish general park hours; observe signs and verify any reserved-area requirements.
